1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Fighter list.

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

options.name: Archery
options.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

options.name: Defense
options.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

1.name: Second Wind
1.description: You can use a Bonus Action to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of three Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 3 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, take one additional action on your turn.

3.name: Martial Archetype
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your fighting style for the rest of your career.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A Fighter who focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. The simplicity of the archetype makes it ideal for newcomers, while still offering elite martial output.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete
7.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

10.name: Additional Fighting Style
10.description: You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

options.name: Archery
options.description: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

options.name: Defense
options.description: While wearing armor, +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: +2 damage when wielding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapons.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice with two-handed melee weapons.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack when two-weapon fighting.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Wizard list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You know three cantrips and have a spellbook with six 1st-level spells.

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per day after a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots up to half your Wizard level.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 4 skills from your Rogue list.

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At level 6, you gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. You don't need Advantage if an ally is within 5 feet of the target, the ally isn't Incapacitated, and you don't have Disadvantage. The extra damage matches the weapon's damage type and scales with your rogue level.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.description: You know Thieves' Cant — a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. You also know one other language of your choice.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: On your turn, you can take one of the following as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

grantedActions.name: Dash
grantedActions.description: Gain extra movement equal to your Speed for the current turn.

grantedActions.name: Disengage
grantedActions.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.

grantedActions.name: Hide
grantedActions.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide, per the Hide action.

3.name: Rogue Subclass
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your roguish style for the rest of your career.

3.name: Steady Aim
3.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. You can only use this if you haven't moved this turn, and after using it your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one Cunning Strike effect by forgoing the listed number of Sneak Attack dice (DC = 8 + DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus). Initial options: Poison (1d6) — Con save or Poisoned for 1 minute; Trip (1d6) — Dex save or Prone (Large or smaller); Withdraw (1d6) — move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: When a visible attacker hits you, use your Reaction to halve the damage (round down).

grantedActions.name: Uncanny Dodge
grantedActions.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, use your Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

6.name: Expertise
6.description: Gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies of your choice.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 more skill proficiencies for Expertise

7.name: Evasion
7.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.description: When making an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

10.name: Ability Score Improvement
10.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.description: You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.description: You learn new Cunning Strike options: Daze (2d6) — Con save or on its next turn it can only do one of move, action, or bonus action; Knock Out (6d6) — Con save or Unconscious for 1 minute (repeats save each turn); Obscure (3d6) — Dex save or Blinded until the end of its next turn.

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

18.name: Elusive
18.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.description: If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: A classic adventurer who hunts for treasure. Thieves are skilled at climbing, jumping, using items quickly, and eventually attuning to more magic items than usual.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following: make a Sleight of Hand check to pick a lock, disarm a trap, or pick a pocket; take the Utilize action; or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires it.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Climber: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Jumper: Determine jump distance using your Dexterity rather than Strength.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: You learn the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option. When you deal Sneak Attack damage and have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover. Cost: 1d6.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: Attunement: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. Charges: When using a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a 6, use it without expending charges. Scrolls: You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. Cantrips and level 1 spells work reliably; for higher levels, succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 + spell level) or the scroll disintegrates.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: You take two turns during the first round of any combat. Your first turn is at your normal Initiative; your second turn is at Initiative minus 10.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Barbarian list.

1.name: Rage
1.description: You can enter a Rage as a Bonus Action. While raging, melee weapon attacks you make with Strength deal extra damage (Rage Damage). The Rage lasts up to 10 rounds and ends early if you don't attack or take damage on your turn.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Paladin list.

1.name: Lay on Hands
1.description: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature and draw from the pool to restore Hit Points equal to the amount you spend (maximum: 5 × your Paladin level). You can also expend 5 points to remove the Poisoned condition. Spend from the pool below; v1 has no targeted-heal prompt.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

options.name: Defense
options.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

2.name: Paladin's Smite
2.description: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon, you can expend a spell slot to deal extra Radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects granted by your subclass. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Faithful Steed
5.description: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared, and you can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain that free use when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Aura of Protection
6.description: You and allies within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) while you are conscious. (Mechanical save bonus not yet applied automatically — add it to rolls manually.)

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

10.name: Aura of Courage
10.description: You and allies within 10 feet of you have Immunity to the Frightened condition while you are conscious.

11.name: Radiant Strikes
11.description: Your strikes carry divine power: when you hit with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage. (Not yet folded into damage rolls automatically — add 1d8 radiant manually.)

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

14.name: Restoring Touch
14.description: When you use Lay on Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of these conditions: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. Each removed condition costs 5 points from the pool.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

18.name: Aura Expansion
18.description: Your Aura of Protection extends to 30 feet instead of 10 feet.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice. (Feat catalog not yet authored — record your pick in notes.)

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Cleric list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus, and you can cast prepared Cleric spells with the Ritual tag as rituals.

1.name: Divine Order
1.description: You have dedicated yourself to one sacred role. Protector: trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor. Thaumaturge: you know one extra Cleric cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier to Arcana and Religion checks. (Picks are recorded; the granted proficiencies/cantrip aren't auto-applied yet.)

options.name: Protector
options.description: Trained for battle: gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.description: You know one extra Cleric cantrip, and add your Wisdom modifier to Intelligence (Arcana) and Intelligence (Religion) checks.

2.name: Channel Divinity
2.description: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes. Divine Spark (Magic action): point your Holy Symbol at a creature within 30 feet — roll 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier and either restore that many Hit Points or force a Constitution save against that much Radiant or Necrotic damage (half on success). The d8 becomes 2d8 at level 7, 3d8 at 13, and 4d8 at 18 — add the extra dice manually for now. Turn Undead (Magic action): each undead within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute. You regain one expended use on a Short Rest, and all uses on a Long Rest.

3.name: Cleric Subclass
3.description: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice, a specialization that grants you features at level 3 and again at levels 6 and 17.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

5.name: Sear Undead
5.description: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die) — each undead that fails its save takes Radiant damage equal to the roll's total. This damage doesn't end the turn effect.

7.name: Blessed Strikes
7.description: Divine power infuses you in battle. Divine Strike: once per turn when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage. Potent Spellcasting: add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips. (Picks are recorded; the bonus damage isn't auto-applied yet.)

options.name: Divine Strike
options.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with your Cleric cantrips.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

10.name: Divine Intervention
10.description: You can call on your deity to intervene: as a Magic action, cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without expending a spell slot or needing material components. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

14.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
14.description: Your Blessed Strikes option improves. Divine Strike: the extra damage increases to 2d8. Potent Spellcasting: when you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet — temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice. (Feat catalog not yet authored — record your pick in notes.)

20.name: Greater Divine Intervention
20.description: When you use Divine Intervention, you can cast Wish with it. When you do, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.description: The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life: soothing the hurt and the sick, and standing against the forces of death.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 + the slot's level. (Add the bonus manually for now.)

3.name: Life Domain Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Mass Healing Word, Revivify, and more as you gain levels. (Only some of these are in the bundled spell list so far — add the rest from the picker when authored.)

3.name: Preserve Life
3.description: Channel Divinity option (Magic action): present your Holy Symbol and distribute Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (none can exceed half its HP max). Spend one Channel Divinity use from the resources card when you use this.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well: when you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to a creature other than you, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 + the slot's level.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll — use the highest number possible for each die.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: You gain proficiency in any three skills of your choice.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma. You know two cantrips from the Bard list and prepare Bard spells from the whole list (4 to start, growing with level). You can cast any prepared spell with the Ritual tag as a ritual, and use a Musical Instrument as your spellcasting focus.

1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.description: As a Bonus Action, inspire a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you, giving it a Bardic Inspiration die (d6). Within the next hour, once, it can roll the die and add it to a failed D20 Test. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier; regain on a Long Rest. The die grows to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 15.

2.name: Expertise
2.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice (your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks with them).

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill you lack proficiency in and that doesn't already use your Proficiency Bonus. (Apply manually.)

3.name: Bard Subclass
3.description: Choose a Bard college (subclass). You gain its features of your Bard level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Font of Inspiration
5.description: You regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action) to regain one expended use. (Short-rest recovery is tracked manually for now — the pool refreshes on a Long Rest.)

7.name: Countercharm
7.description: As a Reaction, when you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against being Charmed or Frightened, you can cause that save to be rerolled with Advantage.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

9.name: Expertise
9.description: You gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 more skill proficiencies for Expertise

10.name: Magical Secrets
10.description: Whenever your number of prepared spells increases, you may choose those new spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists; they count as Bard spells for you. (Cross-list prepared spells are tracked manually.)

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

18.name: Superior Inspiration
18.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two (if you had fewer).

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice for which you qualify (Boon of Spell Recall recommended).

20.name: Words of Creation
20.description: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared. When you cast either, you can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.description: Bards who collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, excelling at versatility and turning others' efforts against them.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and subtract the rolled die from the creature's roll — reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

6.name: Magical Discoveries
6.description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists (cantrip or a level you have slots for). You always have them prepared; they count as Bard spells.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and add it — potentially turning the failure into a success. On a failure, the use isn't expended.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Religion.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know four cantrips and prepare Sorcerer spells from the whole list (2 to start, growing with level). You can use an Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

1.name: Innate Sorcery
1.description: As a Bonus Action, unleash your innate magic for 1 minute: your Sorcerer spell save DC increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast. Two uses; regain on a Long Rest.

2.name: Font of Magic
2.description: You have Sorcery Points (equal to your Sorcerer level from level 2 on) that fuel Metamagic and other options. Convert a spell slot to Sorcery Points equal to its level (no action); or, as a Bonus Action, spend Sorcery Points to create a spell slot (1st=2, 2nd=3, 3rd=5, 4th=6, 5th=7 SP; max 5th). Regain all on a Long Rest.

2.name: Metamagic
2.description: You can alter your spells. Choose Metamagic options (2 at level 2, 4 at level 10, 6 at level 17); spend Sorcery Points to apply them.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you cast a spell forcing saves, choose up to your Charisma modifier of creatures to automatically succeed (and take no damage if they'd take half).

options.name: Distant Spell
options.description: 1 SP: double a spell's range (or make a Touch spell 30 ft).

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.description: 1 SP: reroll up to your Charisma modifier of a spell's damage dice. Stacks with one other Metamagic option.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.description: 1 SP: double a spell's duration (max 24 hours); Advantage on Concentration saves for it.

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.description: 2 SP: give one target Disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.description: 2 SP: change an Action-cast spell to a Bonus Action for this casting.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you miss with a spell attack, reroll the d20. Stacks with one other Metamagic option.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.description: 1 SP: cast a spell without Verbal, Somatic, or (non-costly) Material components.

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.description: 1 SP: change a spell's Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison/Thunder damage to another of those types.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you cast a spell that can be upcast to add a target, increase its effective level by 1 to target one more creature.

3.name: Sorcerer Subclass
3.description: Choose a Sorcerer subclass; you gain its features of your Sorcerer level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Sorcerous Restoration
5.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain expended Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level (round down), once per Long Rest. (Short-rest recovery is tracked manually.)

7.name: Sorcery Incarnate
7.description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can activate it by spending 2 Sorcery Points. While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use up to two Metamagic options on each spell you cast.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

10.name: Metamagic
10.description: You learn two more Metamagic options (handled by the Metamagic picker, which now allows 4 picks).

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

17.name: Metamagic
17.description: You learn two more Metamagic options (the Metamagic picker now allows 6 picks).

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice for which you qualify (Boon of Dimensional Travel recommended).

20.name: Arcane Apotheosis
20.description: While your Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

subclasses.name: Draconic Sorcery
subclasses.description: Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon, granting draconic resilience, elemental affinity, and eventually wings.

3.name: Draconic Resilience
3.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 again each time you gain a Sorcerer level. While you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier. (HP/AC are tracked manually for now.)

3.name: Draconic Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared at given Sorcerer levels — L3: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; L5: Fear, Fly; L7: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; L9: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon. (Authored as text; these spells aren't all bundled yet.)

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.description: Choose a damage type associated with dragons (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison). You have Resistance to it, and when you cast a spell that deals that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

options.name: Acid
options.description: Resistance to Acid; add CHA to one Acid damage roll.

options.name: Cold
options.description: Resistance to Cold; add CHA to one Cold damage roll.

options.name: Fire
options.description: Resistance to Fire; add CHA to one Fire damage roll.

options.name: Lightning
options.description: Resistance to Lightning; add CHA to one Lightning damage roll.

options.name: Poison
options.description: Resistance to Poison; add CHA to one Poison damage roll.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.description: As a Bonus Action, sprout draconic wings for 1 hour (or until dismissed), gaining a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Once per Long Rest, or by spending 3 Sorcery Points to restore the use.

18.name: Dragon Companion
18.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, and once without a spell slot (regaining that use on a Long Rest).

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Druid list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Druid spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. After a Long Rest you can change your prepared spells; you can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus, and cast prepared Druid spells with the Ritual tag as rituals.

1.name: Druidic
1.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids, and can use it to leave hidden messages. You also always have the Druidcraft cantrip prepared (it doesn't count against your cantrips known).

1.name: Primal Order
1.description: You have dedicated yourself to a sacred role. Magician: you know one extra Druid cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier to your Intelligence (Arcana/Nature) checks. Warden: you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor. (Picks are recorded; the granted proficiencies/cantrip aren't auto-applied yet.)

options.name: Magician
options.description: One extra Druid cantrip; add WIS to Arcana and Nature checks.

options.name: Warden
options.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor.

2.name: Wild Shape
2.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use to transform into a Beast form you've learned (Wild Shape forms aren't modeled on the sheet yet — track your assumed form manually). You regain one use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest.

2.name: Wild Companion
2.description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast the Find Familiar spell without Material components; the familiar is Fey and lasts a number of hours equal to half your Druid level.

3.name: Druid Subclass
3.description: Choose a Druid subclass (a Primal Circle); you gain its features of your Druid level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

18.name: Beast Spells
18.description: While using Wild Shape, you can cast spells with Verbal and Somatic components, using your beast form's mouth and limbs to satisfy them.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice for which you qualify (Boon of Spell Recall recommended).

20.name: Archdruid
20.description: Your Wild Shape uses are effectively unlimited, you ignore Verbal/Somatic/Material components of Druid spells, and you can convert unexpended spell slots into Wild Shape uses. You also age more slowly.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: A mystic druid whose magic is shaped by a chosen land — arid, polar, temperate, or tropical — granting extra prepared spells and the ability to recover magic by communing with nature.

3.name: Circle of the Land
3.description: Choose a type of land. While in this Circle you always have its circle spells prepared at Druid levels 3/5/7/9 (the SRD per-land spell lists aren't all bundled yet — track your land's spells manually). You also learn one extra Druid cantrip.

options.name: Arid
options.description: Deserts and savannahs — fire and lightning magic.

options.name: Polar
options.description: Frozen lands — cold and control magic.

options.name: Temperate
options.description: Forests and grasslands — lightning and movement magic.

options.name: Tropical
options.description: Jungles and swamps — poison, acid, and illusion magic.

3.name: Land's Aid
3.description: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to channel life force into a point within 60 feet: one creature there makes a Constitution save (your spell save DC), taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failure (half on success), and a different creature of your choice there regains 2d6 Hit Points. Both dice increase by 1d6 at Druid levels 10 (+1d6) and 14 (+1d6).

6.name: Natural Recovery
6.description: You can cast one of your circle spells without a spell slot once per Long Rest. Additionally, when you finish a Short Rest you can recover expended spell slots whose combined level is up to half your Druid level (rounded up); none can be 6th level or higher. (Slot recovery is tracked manually.)

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.description: You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your circle's land. You also can't be charmed or frightened by Elementals or Fey.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.description: As a Magic action, you create a 15-foot Cube of protective energy within 120 feet for 1 minute. You and your allies in it have Half Cover and gain your choice of resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage; you can move the Cube 60 feet as a Bonus Action.
